limitations: Source-owned renderer admission only; opaque owners remain in the actual ExtensionManager instance.
No IPC, main freeze, archive/paths admission, START, adoption or release is granted.
Failure preserves acquired holds; known-success slot finalization remains a later coordinated source step.
Trusted source integration and actual Redux store identity are required; no arbitrary privileged JavaScript isolation claim.
Invalidation rejects only the waiting admission observer; actual renderer load and acknowledged persistence work are never cancelled or refunded.
